name: @zheexinn/dsh-memory
description: Long-term shared memory plugin for the DeepSeek Harness: LLM auto-extraction, fusion recall (semantic + entity graph), self-maintenance, own-your-storage file backend, remote API & MCP

scripts.test: node scripts/pipeline-test.mjs && node scripts/hub-test.mjs && node scripts/external-test.mjs && node scripts/vector-test.mjs && node scripts/graph-test.mjs && node scripts/mcp-test.mjs
